name: PSS Co.,Ltd.
summary: PSS Co., Ltd., based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, develops and supplies a diverse range of automated systems. Their core services include cloud-based solutions for managing both parking facilities and visitor access. The company's product portfolio extends to various self-service kiosks designed for efficiency across multiple sectors. This includes automated payment terminals for medical services, different models of self-service machines for fuel dispensing (such as insert-type, compound, and double-sided card swiping units), and both desktop and vertical ordering systems. They also provide smart ticketing machines for vending, gate clearance, and shutdown functions, as well as temporary guest and swing gate control units. For parking management, PSS offers an extensive suite of equipment. This encompasses essential access control components like vehicle identification and subtitle displays for entry and exit, IC ticket dispensers and inspectors, multi-card verification systems, and automatic barriers. More advanced parking technologies include electronic toll collection points, automatic car braking systems, sophisticated 3D license plate recognition cameras and integrated systems (including their PSS-PARK smart identification group), and ultrasonic presence detectors for optimizing space usage. Furthermore, PSS enhances its hardware offerings with intelligent cloud integration services.
